name: cantors_theorem
statement: theorem cantors_theorem {A: Type u} {S: A → Set A}: ¬∃ a', {a: A | a ∉ S a} = S a'
proof:
:=
  fun ⟨b, hb⟩ =>
    if hb': b ∈ S b then
      absurd hb' (show b ∈ {a | a ∉ S a} from hb.symm ▸ hb')
    else
      absurd (hb.symm ▸ hb') hb'

name: any_eq'
statement: protected lemma any_eq' (hf: ∀ x y, pred (x ++ y) = (pred x && pred y)): (l₁.any pred && l₂.any pred) = (l₁.product l₂).any (pred ∘ (fun (x, y) => x ++ y))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [List.any_eq, ←Bool.decide_and]
  congr 1
  apply propext
  constructor
  · intro ⟨⟨x, hx₁, hx₂⟩, ⟨y, hy₁, hy₂⟩⟩
    refine ⟨(x, y), List.pair_mem_product.mpr ⟨hx₁, hy₁⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [Function.comp_apply, hf, hx₂, hy₂, Bool.and_self]
  · intro ⟨(x, y), hxy₁, hxy₂⟩
    rw [List.pair_mem_product] at hxy₁
    rw [Function.comp_apply, hf x y, Bool.and_eq_true] at hxy₂
    exact ⟨⟨x, hxy₁.left, hxy₂.left⟩, ⟨y, hxy₁.right, hxy₂.right⟩⟩

name: all_eq'
statement: protected lemma all_eq' (hf: ∀ x y, pred (x ++ y) = (pred x || pred y)): (l₁.all pred || l₂.all pred) = (l₁.product l₂).all (pred ∘ (fun (x, y) => x ++ y))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [List.all_eq, ←Bool.decide_or]
  congr 1
  apply propext
  constructor
  · rintro (h|h) ⟨x, y⟩ hxy
    all_goals
      have ⟨hx, hy⟩ := (List.pair_mem_product.mp hxy)
      have := h _ (by assumption)
      rw [Function.comp_apply, hf, this]
      simp only [Bool.true_or, Bool.or_true]
  · intro h
    apply Classical.or_iff_not_imp_left.mpr
    push_neg
    intro ⟨x, hx₁, hx₂⟩ y hy
    have := h (x, y) (List.pair_mem_product.mpr ⟨hx₁, hy⟩)
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, hf x y, Bool.or_eq_true] at this
    exact this.resolve_left hx₂

name: truth_eq_disjNF'
statement:
lemma truth_eq_disjNF' {t: A → Bool}: ∀ {p: Prop' A}, truth t p = truth t (disjNF' p)
| .true | .false | .atom _ => rfl
| .or q r => by
  rw [disjNF', disjNF, List.map_append, List.map_append, truth_disj_append, truth]
  congr 1
  all_goals
    rw [←truth_disj, ←disjNF']
    exact truth_eq_disjNF'
| .and q r => by
  have hq
proof:
:= truth_eq_disjNF' (t := t) (p := q)
  have hr := truth_eq_disjNF' (t := t) (p := r)
  rw [truth, hq, hr]
  simp only [truth_disj, disjNF', List.map_map, List.any_map]
  apply List.any_eq'
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, List.unattach_append, truth_conj, List.all_append, implies_true]

name: truth_eq_conjNF'
statement:
lemma truth_eq_conjNF' {t: A → Bool}: ∀ {p: Prop' A}, truth t p = truth t (conjNF' p)
| .true | .false | .atom _ => rfl
| .and q r => by
  rw [conjNF', conjNF, List.map_append, List.map_append, truth_conj_append, truth]
  congr 1
  all_goals
    rw [←truth_conj, ←conjNF']
    exact truth_eq_conjNF'
| .or q r => by
  have hq
proof:
:= truth_eq_conjNF' (t := t) (p := q)
  have hr := truth_eq_conjNF' (t := t) (p := r)
  rw [truth, hq, hr]
  simp only [truth_conj, conjNF', List.map_map, List.all_map]
  apply List.all_eq'
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, List.unattach_append, truth_disj, List.any_append, implies_true]

name: length_one_iff

name: length_gt_one_iff
statement: lemma length_gt_one_iff: length p > 1 ↔ (∃ q, p = not q) ∨ (∃ q r, p = or q r) ∨ (∃ q r, p = and q r)
proof:
:=
  calc _
    _ ↔ ¬(length p = 1) :=
      match h: p.length with
      | 0 => absurd h (Nat.ne_of_gt length_pos)
      | 1 | _ + 2 => by simp [h]
    _ ↔ ¬(p = ⊤ ∨ p = ⊥ ∨ ∃ a, p = atom a) := not_congr length_one_iff
    _ ↔ _ := by cases hp: p <;> simp [hp]

name: truth_of_implies

  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, truth_of_implies]
  cases (truth t p) <;> cases (truth t q) <;> decide

name: tautologicalConsequence_and
statement: lemma tautologicalConsequence_and: S ⊨ and p q ↔ S ⊨ p ∧ S ⊨ q
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    constructor
    all_goals
      intro t ht
      have := h t ht
      rw [truth, Bool.and_eq_true] at this
      simp only [this]
  · intro ⟨hl, hr⟩
    intro t ht
    rw [truth, Bool.and_eq_true]
    exact ⟨hl t ht, hr t ht⟩

name: tautologicalConsequence_of_union
statement: lemma tautologicalConsequence_of_union: S ∪ {p} ⊨ q ↔ S ⊨ P![p → q]
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h t ht
    apply truth_of_implies.mpr
    intro hp
    apply h t
    rintro p' (hp'|hp')
    · exact ht p' hp'
    · exact hp' ▸ hp
  · intro h t ht
    apply (truth_of_implies (p := p)).mp
    · apply h
      apply left_models_of_union ht
    · apply right_models_of_union ht
      rfl

:= by
  intro h ⟨t, ht⟩
  have h₁ := ht (not p) (Set.mem_union_right S rfl)
  have h₂ := h t (antitone_models (Set.subset_union_left) ht)
  rw [truth, h₂] at h₁
  contradiction

name: truth_disj
statement:
@[simp]
lemma truth_disj {ps: List (Prop' A)}: truth t (disj ps) = ps.any (truth t)
proof:
:=
  match ps with
  | [] => rfl
  | p₀ :: ps' => by
    dsimp [disj]
    apply (List.eq_nil_or_concat' ps').elim
    · intro h
      simp only [h, List.foldl_nil, List.any_nil, Bool.or_false]
    · intro ⟨front, pLast, h⟩
      rw [h, List.foldl_concat, truth, List.any_append,
          List.any_cons, List.any_nil, Bool.or_false, ←Bool.or_assoc]
      congr 1
      rw [←disj, ←List.any]
      apply truth_disj

name: truth_conj
statement:
@[simp]
lemma truth_conj {ps: List (Prop' A)}: truth t (conj ps) = ps.all (truth t)
proof:
:=
  match ps with
  | [] => rfl
  | p₀ :: ps' => by
    dsimp [conj]
    apply (List.eq_nil_or_concat' ps').elim
    · intro h
      simp only [h, List.foldl_nil, List.all_nil, Bool.and_true]
    · intro ⟨front, pLast, h⟩
      rw [h, List.foldl_concat, truth, List.all_append,
          List.all_cons, List.all_nil, Bool.and_true, ←Bool.and_assoc]
      congr 1
      rw [←conj, ←List.all]
      apply truth_conj

@[simp]

name: truth_disj_and_disj
statement: lemma truth_disj_and_disj: truth t P![{disj ps} ∧ {disj qs}] = ((ps.product qs).any fun (p, q) => truth t (and p q))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [truth, truth_disj, List.any_eq, ←Bool.decide_and, Bool.and_eq_true, Prod.exists,
    List.pair_mem_product, decide_eq_decide]

name: truth_conj_or_conj
statement: lemma truth_conj_or_conj: truth t P![{conj ps} ∨ {conj qs}] = ((ps.product qs).all fun (p, q) => truth t (or p q))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [truth, truth_conj, List.all_eq, ←Bool.decide_or, Bool.or_eq_true, Prod.forall,
    List.pair_mem_product, and_imp, decide_eq_decide]
  constructor
  · rintro (h|h) _ _ ha hb
    <;> simp only [ha, hb, h, true_or, or_true]
  · intro h
    by_contra hn
    push_neg at hn
    have ⟨⟨x, hx₁, hx₂⟩, ⟨y, hy₁, hy₂⟩⟩ := hn
    apply (h x y hx₁ hy₁).elim <;> assumption

name: satisfying.truth_of_matchingAtoms
statement: lemma satisfying.truth_of_matchingAtoms {ts: List (A → Bool)}: truth t (matchingAtoms Fintype.elems.toList ts) = decide (t ∈ ts)
proof:
:= by
  unfold matchingAtoms
  rw [truth_disj, List.any_map, List.any_eq]
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, truth_conj, List.all_map, List.all_eq_true, Finset.mem_toList]
  simp only [Fintype.complete, forall_const]
  symm
  apply Bool.decide_congr
  constructor
  · intro h
    exists t, h
    intro a
    split_ifs with h'
    · exact h'
    · exact Bool.not_iff_not.mpr h'
  · intro ⟨t', ht'₁, ht'₂⟩
    convert ht'₁
    funext a
    have := ht'₂ a
    split_ifs at this with h'
    · rwa [h']
    · simp_all [h', this, truth]

name: truth_of_satisfying
statement: lemma truth_of_satisfying {f: (A → Bool) → Bool}: truth t (satisfying f) = f t
proof:
:= by
  simp [satisfying, truth, satisfying.truth_of_matchingAtoms, Fintype.complete]

name: exists_prop_for_truth_table
statement: theorem exists_prop_for_truth_table (f: (A → Bool) → Bool): ∃ p, f = fₚ p
proof:
:=
  ⟨satisfying f, funext fun _ => truth_of_satisfying.symm⟩

name: bijective_quotient_satisfying
statement: lemma bijective_quotient_satisfying [Fintype A]: Function.Bijective (⟦satisfying ·⟧) (β := EquivalenceQuotient A)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro f g h
    rw [Quotient.eq] at h
    funext t
    have := h t
    rwa [truth_of_iff, truth_of_satisfying, truth_of_satisfying] at this
  · apply Quotient.ind
    intro p
    use fₚ p
    rw [Quotient.eq]
    intro t
    rw [truth_of_iff, truth_of_satisfying]

name: card_quotient
statement: theorem card_quotient [Finite A]: Fintype.card (EquivalenceQuotient A) = 2 ^ 2 ^ Fintype.card A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [←Fintype.card_of_bijective bijective_quotient_satisfying,
    Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_bool]

name: not_
statement:
lemma not_ε: Admissible w → w ≠ ε
| .nullary ..
| .concat .. => List.cons_ne_nil _ _

name: readability
statement:
lemma readability (hw: Admissible w): ∃ (f: F) (ts: List (Word F)),
w = f :: ts.flatten ∧ (∀ t ∈ ts, Admissible t) ∧ ts.length = arity f
proof:
:=
  match hw with
  | .nullary f hf => ⟨f, [], rfl, List.forall_mem_nil _, hf.symm⟩
  | .concat f _ ts hts₁ hts₂ => ⟨f, ts, rfl, hts₁, hts₂⟩

name: nullary_of_singleton
statement: lemma nullary_of_singleton (h: Admissible [f]): arity f = 0
proof:
:=
  Admissible.recOn (motive := fun x hx => x = [f] → arity f = 0) h
    (fun x hx₁ hx₂ => List.head_eq_of_cons_eq hx₂ ▸ hx₁)
    (fun x hx₁ ts hts₁ hts₂ _ heq => by
      absurd (hts₂ ▸ hx₁)
      rw [not_lt, Nat.le_zero_eq, List.length_eq_zero_iff]
      apply ε_of_flatten_ε
      · assumption
      · exact List.tail_eq_of_cons_eq heq)
    rfl

name: List.of_prefix_append_equal_lengths
statement:
private lemma List.of_prefix_append_equal_lengths {α: Type u} {x y z w: List α}
: x ++ y <+: z ++ w → x.length = z.length → x = z ∧ y <+: w
| h₁, h₂ =>
  have ⟨s, t⟩
proof:
:= h₁
  have ⟨g₁, g₂⟩ := List.append_inj (List.append_assoc .. ▸ t) h₂
  ⟨g₁, s, g₂⟩

name: of_flatten_append_prefix_of_flatten
statement:
lemma of_flatten_append_prefix_of_flatten {ts us: List (Word F)} {w: Word F}
  (hts: ∀ t ∈ ts, Admissible t) (hus: ∀ u ∈ us, Admissible u)
  (htuw: ts.flatten ++ w = us.flatten)
: ts <+: us ∧ w = (us.drop ts.length).flatten
proof:
:= by
  match us, ts with
  | [], ts =>
    rw [List.flatten_nil, List.append_eq_nil_iff] at htuw
    rw [ε_of_flatten_ε hts htuw.left, htuw.right]
    exact ⟨List.prefix_rfl, rfl⟩
  | u₁ :: us', [] =>
    simp at htuw ⊢
    assumption
  | u₁ :: us', t₁ :: ts' =>
    replace hts := List.forall_mem_cons.mp hts
    replace hus := List.forall_mem_cons.mp hus
    have ⟨h, as, hfas, has₁, has₂⟩ := readability hts.left
    have ⟨h', bs, hfbs, hbs₁, hbs₂⟩ := readability hus.left
    have: h = h' := by
      simp [hfas, hfbs] at htuw
      exact htuw.left
    subst this

    simp only [hfas, hfbs, List.flatten_cons, List.cons_append,
               List.cons_inj_right, ←List.flatten_append] at htuw
    have hlength_as_bs: as.length = bs.length := hbs₂.symm ▸ has₂
    have ⟨hprefixes, hw⟩ := of_flatten_append_prefix_of_flatten 
      (List.forall_mem_append.mpr ⟨has₁, hts.right⟩)
      (List.forall_mem_append.mpr ⟨hbs₁, hus.right⟩)
      htuw
    rw [List.length_append, hlength_as_bs, List.drop_append] at hw

    replace ⟨heq_as_bs, hprefixes⟩ :=
      List.of_prefix_append_equal_lengths hprefixes hlength_as_bs
    simp only [hfas, hfbs, List.cons_prefix_cons, List.length_cons, List.drop_succ_cons]
    exact ⟨⟨heq_as_bs ▸ rfl, hprefixes⟩, hw⟩

name: List.forall_drop
statement:
private lemma List.forall_drop {α: Type u} {l: List α} {p: α → Prop} (n: ℕ) (h: ∀ a ∈ l, p a)
: ∀ a ∈ l.drop n, p a
proof:
:=
  fun a ha => h a (List.mem_of_mem_drop ha)

name: flatten_inj
statement:
lemma flatten_inj (hts: ∀ t ∈ ts, Admissible t) (hus: ∀ u ∈ us, Admissible u)
(heq: ts.flatten = us.flatten): ts = us
proof:
:=
  have ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := of_flatten_append_prefix_of_flatten
    hts hus ((List.append_nil ts.flatten).symm ▸ heq)
  have := ε_of_flatten_ε (List.forall_drop ts.length hus) h₂.symm
  List.IsPrefix.eq_of_length_le h₁ (List.drop_eq_nil_iff.mp this)

name: append_inj
statement: lemma append_inj (ht: Admissible t) (hu: Admissible u) (heq: t ++ w = u): t = u ∧ w = ε
proof:
:=
  have ⟨_, h⟩ := of_flatten_append_prefix_of_flatten (w := w)
    (List.forall_mem_singleton.mpr ht)
    (List.forall_mem_singleton.mpr hu)
    (List.flatten_singleton.symm ▸ List.flatten_singleton.symm ▸ heq)

  have: w = (List.drop 0 []).flatten :=
    List.drop_succ_cons ▸ List.length_singleton ▸ h
  have: w = [] := this
  ⟨List.append_nil t ▸ this ▸ heq, this⟩

name: eq_of_prefix
statement: lemma eq_of_prefix (ht: Admissible t) (hu: Admissible u) (htu: t <+: u): t = u
proof:
:=
  have ⟨_, hw⟩ := htu
  (append_inj ht hu hw).left

name: eq_prefix_of_eq
statement: lemma eq_prefix_of_eq (ht: Admissible t) (hv: Admissible v) (htuvw: t ++ u = v ++ w): t = v
proof:
:=
  (List.append_eq_append_iff.mp htuvw).elim
    (fun ⟨_, h₁, _⟩ => (append_inj ht hv h₁.symm).left)
    (fun ⟨_, h₁, _⟩ => (append_inj hv ht h₁.symm).left.symm)

name: unique_readability
statement:
lemma unique_readability (hw: Admissible w)
: ∃! fts: F × List (Word F), w = fts.1 :: fts.2.flatten ∧ (∀ t ∈ fts.2, Admissible t) ∧ fts.2.length = arity fts.1
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨f, ts, h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ := readability hw
  refine ⟨(f, ts), ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃⟩, ?_⟩
  intro (f', ts') ⟨h₁', h₂', h₃'⟩
  dsimp at h₁' h₂' h₃'
  have ⟨hf, this⟩ := List.cons.inj (h₁' ▸ h₁)
  have hts := flatten_inj h₂' h₂ this
  rw [hf, hts]

name: unique_prefix_and_suffix
statement:
lemma unique_prefix_and_suffix (h₁: w = w₁ ++ v ++ w₂) (h₂: w₁.length = i)
: w₁ = w.take i ∧ w₂ = w.drop (i + v.length)
proof:
:= by
  rw [←h₂, h₁, List.append_assoc, List.take_left,
      ←List.length_append, ←List.append_assoc, List.drop_left]
  trivial

name: iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma iff: OccursIn v w i ↔ v <+: w.drop i
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro ⟨w₁, w₂, h₁, h₂⟩
    use w₂
    simp only [h₁, ←h₂, List.append_assoc, List.drop_left]
  · intro ⟨w₂, h⟩
    use w.take i, w₂
    constructor
    · rw [List.append_assoc, h, List.take_append_drop]
    · rw [List.length_take_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt i.isLt)]

name: refl
statement: lemma refl (hw: 0 < w.length): OccursIn w w ⟨0, hw⟩
proof:
:=
  ⟨ε, ε, (List.append_nil _).symm, rfl⟩

name: prefix_of_zero
statement: lemma prefix_of_zero {hw: 0 < w.length} (h: OccursIn v w ⟨0, hw⟩): v <+: w
proof:
:=
  iff.mp h

name: to_succ
statement:
lemma to_succ (hi: i < w.length) (h: OccursIn v w ⟨i, hi⟩)
: OccursIn v (f :: w) ⟨i + 1, Nat.add_lt_add_right hi 1⟩
proof:
:=
  iff.mpr <| (congrArg _ List.drop_succ_cons).mpr (iff.mp h)

name: ge
statement: lemma ge: k ≥ (ts.take j.j).flatten.length
proof:
:=
  match hj: j.j with
  | ⟨0, _⟩ => Nat.zero_le _
  | ⟨l + 1, hl⟩ => by
    apply Nat.ge_of_not_lt
    intro hn
    have := j.min ⟨l, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hl⟩ hn
    conv at this => right; rw [hj]
    simp only [Fin.mk_le_mk, Nat.not_add_one_le_self] at this

name: offset_lt
statement: lemma offset_lt: j.offset < ts[j.j].length
proof:
:=
  Nat.sub_lt_left_of_lt_add j.ge <|
    calc k.val
      _ < (ts.take (j.j + 1)).flatten.length := j.lt
      _ = (ts.take j.j).flatten.length + ts[j.j].length := by
        rw [List.take_succ, List.getElem?_eq_getElem j.j.isLt, Option.toList_some]
        rw [List.flatten_append, List.length_append, List.flatten_singleton]
        rfl

name: occurs_in
statement: lemma occurs_in (h: OccursIn v ts[j.j] ⟨j.offset, j.offset_lt⟩): OccursIn v ts.flatten k
proof:
:=
  have ⟨v₁, v₂, h₁, h₂⟩ := h
  let w₁ := (ts.take j.j).flatten ++ v₁
  let w₂ := v₂ ++ (ts.drop (j.j + 1)).flatten
  have hts := calc ts.flatten
    _ = (ts.take j.j).flatten ++ ts[j.j] ++ (ts.drop (j.j + 1)).flatten := by
      rw [←List.flatten_singleton (l := ts[j.j])]
      simp only [←List.flatten_append]
      simp only [Fin.getElem_fin, List.take_append_getElem, List.take_append_drop]
    _ = w₁ ++ v ++ w₂ := by simp only [h₁, List.append_assoc, w₁, w₂]
  have hw₁ := by
    unfold w₁
    rw [List.length_append, h₂]
    apply Nat.add_sub_of_le
    apply J.ge
  ⟨w₁, w₂, hts, hw₁⟩

name: occurs_in_succ
statement:
lemma occurs_in_succ (h: OccursIn v ts[j.j] ⟨j.offset, j.offset_lt⟩)
: OccursIn v (f :: ts.flatten) ⟨k + 1, Nat.add_one_lt_add_one_iff.mpr k.isLt⟩
proof:
:=
  to_succ k.isLt (j.occurs_in h)

name: exists_admissible_occurring_in
statement: lemma exists_admissible_occurring_in [Arity F] {w: Word F} (hw: Admissible w) (i: Fin w.length): ∃ v, Admissible v ∧ OccursIn v w i
proof:
:=
  match hi: i with
  | ⟨0, h0⟩ => ⟨w, hw, refl h0⟩
  | ⟨k + 1, hk⟩ =>
    have ⟨f, ts, h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ := readability hw
    have hk': k < ts.flatten.length := Nat.add_one_lt_add_one_iff.mp
      (List.length_cons .. ▸ h₁ ▸ hk)
    let j := J.compute ts ⟨k, hk'⟩
    let tj := ts[j.j]
    have htj: Admissible tj := h₂ tj (List.mem_of_getElem rfl)
    let ⟨v, hv₁, hv₂⟩ := exists_admissible_occurring_in (w := tj) htj ⟨j.offset, j.offset_lt⟩
    ⟨v, hv₁, h₁ ▸ j.occurs_in_succ hv₂⟩

name: unique_admissible_occurring_in
statement: lemma unique_admissible_occurring_in [Arity F] (hw: Admissible w) (i: Fin w.length): ∃! v: Word F, Admissible v ∧ OccursIn v w i
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨v, hv₁, hv₂⟩ := exists_admissible_occurring_in hw i
  refine ⟨v, ⟨hv₁, hv₂⟩, ?_⟩
  intro v' ⟨hv'₁, hv'₂⟩
  have ⟨x₁, x₂, h₁, h₂⟩ := hv₂
  have ⟨x'₁, x'₂, h'₁, h'₂⟩ := hv'₂
  rw [h₁, List.append_assoc, List.append_assoc] at h'₁
  have := List.append_inj_right h'₁ (h'₂.symm ▸ h₂)
  symm
  apply eq_prefix_of_eq (u := x₂) (w := x'₂)
  <;> assumption

name: trivial
statement: lemma trivial: ⊨ (⊤: Prop' A)
proof:
:=

name: em

name: substructure_isSubstructure
statement:
lemma substructure_isSubstructure {h: ∀ F (a: Fin (arity F) → A), interpFun ℬ F (a ·) ∈ A}:
    Substructure A ℬ h ⊆ ℬ
proof:
:=
  ⟨h, rfl⟩

name: StrongHom.mk'
statement:
lemma StrongHom.mk' (hom: Hom 𝒜 ℬ h) (hh: ∀ R a, h ∘ a ∈ ℬ.interpRel R → a ∈ 𝒜.interpRel R):
    StrongHom 𝒜 ℬ h where
  hRel R a
proof:
:= ⟨hom.hRel R a, hh R a⟩
  hFun := hom.hFun

name: StrongHom.toHom
statement:
lemma StrongHom.toHom: StrongHom 𝒜 ℬ h → Hom 𝒜 ℬ h
| {hRel, hFun} => ⟨fun R a => (hRel R a).mp, hFun⟩

name: emb_inclusion_map
statement:
lemma emb_inclusion_map {A: Set B} [Nonempty ↑A] {𝒜: Structure L A} {ℬ: Structure L B}
    (h: 𝒜 ⊆ ℬ): Emb 𝒜 ℬ (fun a => a)
proof:
:=
  have ⟨hR, hF⟩ := Structure.mk.inj h.h₂
  { inj := fun _ _ => Subtype.eq,
    hRel _R _a := hR ▸ Iff.rfl
    hFun _F _a := hF ▸ rfl }

name: Substructure.ofHom_bijection_of_emb
statement:
lemma Substructure.ofHom_bijection_of_emb {𝒜: Structure L A} {ℬ: Structure L B} {h: A → B}
    (hh: Emb 𝒜 ℬ h): Iso 𝒜 (ofHom hh.toHom) (⟨h ·, Set.mem_range_self _⟩)
proof:
:=
  have ⟨⟨hRel, hFun⟩, inj⟩ := hh
  { bij := ⟨fun _ _ ha => inj (Subtype.mk.injEq .. ▸ ha),
            fun ⟨_, a, ha⟩ => ⟨a, Subtype.eq ha⟩⟩,
    hRel := hRel,
    hFun := fun F a => Subtype.eq (hFun F a) }

name: hom_comp
statement:
lemma hom_comp (hj: Hom ℬ 𝒞 j) (hi: Hom 𝒜 ℬ i): Hom 𝒜 𝒞 (j ∘ i) where
  hRel R a ha
proof:
:=
    have hj := hj.hRel R (i ∘ a)
    have hi := hi.hRel R a
    hj (hi ha)
  hFun F a :=
    have hj := hj.hFun F (i ∘ a)
    have hi := hi.hFun F a
    show j _ = _ from hi.symm ▸ hj

name: strongHom_comp
statement: lemma strongHom_comp (hj: StrongHom ℬ 𝒞 j) (hi: StrongHom 𝒜 ℬ i): StrongHom 𝒜 𝒞 (j ∘ i)
proof:
:=
  .mk' 𝒜 𝒞 (j ∘ i) (hom_comp hj.toHom hi.toHom) fun R a ha =>
   have hj := (hj.hRel R (i ∘ a)).mpr
   have hi := (hi.hRel R a).mpr
   hi (hj ha)

name: emb_comp
statement:
lemma emb_comp (hj: Emb ℬ 𝒞 j) (hi: Emb 𝒜 ℬ i): Emb 𝒜 𝒞 (j ∘ i) where
  toStrongHom
proof:
:= strongHom_comp hj.toStrongHom hi.toStrongHom
  inj := Function.Injective.comp hj.inj hi.inj

name: iso_comp
statement:
lemma iso_comp (hj: Iso ℬ 𝒞 j) (hi: Iso 𝒜 ℬ i): Iso 𝒜 𝒞 (j ∘ i) where
  toStrongHom
proof:
:= strongHom_comp hj.toStrongHom hi.toStrongHom
  bij := Function.Bijective.comp hj.bij hi.bij

name: auto_comp
statement: lemma auto_comp {j i: A → A} (hj: Auto 𝒜 j) (hi: Auto 𝒜 i): Auto 𝒜 (j ∘ i)
proof:
:=
  iso_comp hj hi

name: auto_id
statement: lemma auto_id: Auto 𝒜 id
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · constructor <;> simp
  · exact Function.bijective_id

name: bijective_invFun_of_bijective
statement:
private lemma bijective_invFun_of_bijective:
    Bijective f → Bijective (invFun f)
| ⟨_, _⟩ => by
  refine bijective_iff_has_inverse.mpr ⟨f, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply RightInverse.leftInverse
    apply rightInverse_invFun
    assumption
  · apply LeftInverse.rightInverse
    apply leftInverse_invFun
    assumption

private lemma comp_invFun (hf: Surjective f): f ∘ invFun f = id
proof:
:=
  funext <| rightInverse_invFun hf

name: comp_invFun
statement: private lemma comp_invFun (hf: Surjective f): f ∘ invFun f = id
proof:
:=
  funext <| rightInverse_invFun hf

name: auto_inv
statement: lemma auto_inv {i: A → A} (hi: Auto 𝒜 i): Auto 𝒜 (invFun i)
proof:
:=
  have ⟨⟨hRel, hFun⟩, hinj, hsur⟩ := hi
  let iInv := invFun i
  { bij := bijective_invFun_of_bijective hi.bij,
    hRel R a := by
      have := hRel R (iInv ∘ a)
      convert this.symm
      rw [←comp_assoc, comp_invFun hsur]
      rfl
    hFun F a := by
      apply hinj
      have := hFun F (iInv ∘ a)
      convert this.symm
      show (i ∘ iInv) ((F^𝒜) a) = (F^𝒜) ((i ∘ iInv) ∘ a)
      repeat rw [comp_invFun hsur]
      rfl }

name: group_hom_iff
statement:
lemma group_hom_iff [Group A] [Group B] {h: A → B}:
    (∀ x y: A, h (x * y) = h x * h y) ↔ Hom (Gr A) (Gr B) h
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hyp => ⟨nofun, fun F as => ?_⟩, fun ⟨hyp₁, hyp₂⟩ x y => ?_⟩
  · have h_one: h 1 = 1 := by
      have: h 1 = h 1 * h 1 := by rw [←hyp, one_mul]
      have := congr_arg (· * (h 1)⁻¹) this
      simp only [mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel, mul_one] at this
      exact this.symm
    have h_inv: ∀ a, h a⁻¹ = (h a)⁻¹ := fun a => by
      apply eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left
      convert (hyp _ _).symm
      convert h_one.symm
      apply inv_mul_cancel
    cases F
    · exact h_one
    · apply h_inv
    · apply hyp
  · let xy: Fin 2 → A | 0 => x | 1 => y
    exact hyp₂ .mul xy

name: Congruence.quotientIsStrongHom
statement:
lemma Congruence.quotientIsStrongHom {A: Type u} [Nonempty A] {𝒜: Structure L A} {c: Congruence 𝒜}:
    StrongHom 𝒜 (quotient 𝒜 c) (fun a => ⟦a⟧)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  case' hRel =>
    intro R a
    apply c.hRel
  case' hFun =>
    intro F a
    apply Quotient.eq.mpr
    apply c.hFun
  all_goals
    intro i
    apply c.hEquiv.symm
    apply Quotient.mk_out (s := c.toSetoid)

name: product_projection_hom
statement:
lemma product_projection_hom (j: I): Hom (product hβ ℬ) (ℬ j) (fun b => b j) where
  hRel _R _b hb
proof:
:= hb j
  hFun _F _b := rfl

name: product_of_homs
statement:
lemma product_of_homs (h: (i: I) → A → β i) (hyp: ∀ i, Hom 𝒜 (ℬ i) (h i)):
    Hom 𝒜 (product hβ ℬ) (fun a i => h i a) where
  hRel R a ha i
proof:
:= (hyp i).hRel R a ha
  hFun F a := funext fun i => (hyp i).hFun F a

name: var_inj
statement: lemma var_inj: ∀ {m n: ℕ}, var (V := V) m = var n → m = n
proof:
:=
  @var.inj'

name: isConstant_or_isGe_of_add
statement:
lemma isConstant_or_isGe_of_add:
    isConstantOrGe u → isConstantOrGe v
    → isConstantOrGe (fun n => u n + v n)
| .inl ⟨yu, hu⟩, .inl ⟨yv, hv⟩ =>
  .inl ⟨yu + yv, fun n => by rw [←hu n, ←hv n]⟩
| _, .inr hv => .inr fun n => calc
  n ≤ v n
proof:
:= hv n
  _ ≤ u n + v n := Nat.le_add_left ..

name: isConstant_or_isGe_of_mul
statement:
lemma isConstant_or_isGe_of_mul:
    isConstantOrGe u → isConstantOrGe v
    → isConstantOrGe (fun n => u n * v n)
| .inl ⟨yu, hu⟩, .inl ⟨yv, hv⟩ =>
  .inl ⟨yu * yv, fun n => by rw [←hu n, ←hv n]⟩
| .inr hu, .inr hv => .inr fun
  | 0 => Nat.zero_le _
  | k + 1 => calc
    _ ≤ u (k + 1)
proof:
:= hu _
    _ ≤ _ := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ <|
      have := hv (k + 1)
      by omega

name: not_exists_nat_rig_term
statement:
theorem not_exists_nat_rig_term₁ : ¬∃ (t: Term .Rig V) (x: V) (hx: areVarsFor {x} t),
    interp t 𝒩 hx (fun _ => 0) = 1 ∧ interp t 𝒩 hx (fun _ => 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  push_neg
  intro t x hx
  let f n := interp t 𝒩 hx (fun _ => n)
  
  suffices isConstantOrGe f by
    match this with
    | .inl ⟨y, hy⟩ =>
      intro (h₀: f 0 = 1) (h₁: f 1 = 0)
      rw [hy 0] at h₀
      rw [hy 1, h₀] at h₁
      contradiction
    | .inr h =>
      intro _ (h₁: f 1 = 0)
      replace h := h 1
      rw [h₁] at h
      contradiction

  induction t with
  | var v => simp [f, interp]
  | app F ts ih =>
    cases hF : F <;> subst hF
    · exact .inl ⟨0, fun n => rfl⟩
    · exact .inl ⟨1, fun n => rfl⟩
    all_goals
      first
      | apply isConstant_or_isGe_of_add
      | apply isConstant_or_isGe_of_mul
      all_goals
        apply ih
        intro v hv
        apply hx
        exact ⟨_, hv⟩

name: eval_mono
statement:
lemma eval_mono: ∀ {p: Poly}, Monotone p.eval
| .const _ => fun _ _ _ => Nat.le_refl _
| .var => fun _ _ => id
| .add _ _ => Monotone.add eval_mono eval_mono
| .mul _ _ => Monotone.mul' eval_mono eval_mono

/
def deg: Poly → ℕ
| .const _ => 0
| .var => 1
| .add p q => max (deg p) (deg q)
| .mul p q => deg p + deg q

/

name: eval_mul_le
statement:
lemma eval_mul_le {a n} (ha: a ≠ 0) : ∀ {p: Poly}, eval p (a * n) ≤ a^(deg p) * eval p n
| .const c | .var => by simp [eval, deg]
| .add q r => calc eval (add q r) (a * n)
  _ = eval q (a * n) + eval r (a * n)
proof:
:= rfl
  _ ≤ a^(deg q) * eval q n + a^(deg r) * eval r n :=
    Nat.add_le_add (eval_mul_le ha) (eval_mul_le ha)
  _ ≤ _ := by
    apply (Nat.le_or_ge (deg q) (deg r)).elim
    · intro h
      simp only [deg, h, sup_of_le_right, eval, Nat.mul_add, add_le_add_iff_right]
      apply Nat.mul_le_mul_right
      apply Nat.pow_le_pow_right <;> simp [*, Nat.zero_lt_of_ne_zero]
    · intro h
      simp only [deg, h, sup_of_le_left, eval, Nat.mul_add, add_le_add_iff_left]
      apply Nat.mul_le_mul_right
      apply Nat.pow_le_pow_right <;> simp [*, Nat.zero_lt_of_ne_zero]

name: eval_le_mul_eval_half
statement:
lemma eval_le_mul_eval_half {p: Poly} {n: ℕ}:
    eval p n ≤ 2^(deg p) * eval p ((n + 1) / 2)
proof:
:= calc _
  _ ≤ eval p (2 * ((n + 1) / 2)) := eval_mono (by omega)
  _ ≤ _ := eval_mul_le (by decide)

name: eval_diverges_from_two_pow
statement:
lemma eval_diverges_from_two_pow: ∀ p m, ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, m * eval p n < 2^n
| .const c, m => ⟨m * c, fun n hn => Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt hn Nat.lt_two_pow_self⟩
| .var, m => ⟨m + 1, fun n hn =>
  have: m ≤ n - 1
proof:
:= Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt hn
  Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt
    (Nat.mul_le_mul_right n this) mul_pred_self_lt_two_pow⟩

name: not_exists_nat_rig_term
statement:
theorem not_exists_nat_rig_term₂ : ¬∃ (t: Term .Rig V) (x: V) (hx: areVarsFor {x} t),
    ∀ n, interp t 𝒩 hx (fun _ => n) = 2^n
proof:
:=
  fun ⟨t, x, hx, h⟩ =>
    let ⟨p, hp⟩ := Poly.ofTerm t hx
    have ⟨N, hN⟩ := Poly.eval_diverges_from_two_pow p 48
    by {
      have := hN N (Nat.le_refl N)
      rw [←h N, hp N] at this
      omega
    }

proof:
:= ⟨
  fun ⟨pf⟩ =>
    have h₁: Proof (S ∪ {not p}) P![p → ¬p → ⊥] := .axiom (.absurd p)
    have h₂: Proof (S ∪ {not p}) P![¬p → ⊥] := .mp p (weakenProof (Set.subset_union_left) pf) h₁
    have h₃: Proof (S ∪ {not p}) (not p) := .assumption (Set.mem_union_right S rfl)
    ⟨.mp (not p) h₃ h₂⟩,
  fun pf =>
    have ⟨pf'⟩ := deduction pf

name: finite_family_of_proof
statement:
lemma finite_family_of_proof: ⋃₀ Sᵢ ⊢ p → ∃ Sᵢ' ⊆ Sᵢ, Sᵢ'.Finite ∧ ⋃₀ Sᵢ' ⊢ p
| ⟨pf⟩ => f pf
where f {p}: Proof (⋃₀ Sᵢ) p → ∃ Sᵢ' ⊆ Sᵢ, Sᵢ'.Finite ∧ ⋃₀ Sᵢ' ⊢ p
  | .axiom h => ⟨∅,
    Set.empty_subset Sᵢ,
    Set.finite_empty,
    Set.sUnion_empty ▸ ⟨.axiom h⟩⟩
  | .mp _r hr hrp =>
    have ⟨Sᵣ, hSᵣ₁, hSᵣ₂, hSᵣ₃⟩
proof:
:= f hr
    have ⟨Sᵣₚ, hSᵣₚ₁, hSᵣₚ₂, hSᵣₚ₃⟩ := f hrp
    ⟨Sᵣ ∪ Sᵣₚ,
      Set.union_subset hSᵣ₁ hSᵣₚ₁,
      Set.Finite.union hSᵣ₂ hSᵣₚ₂,
      mp
        (weaken (Set.sUnion_subset_sUnion Set.subset_union_left) hSᵣ₃)
        (weaken (Set.sUnion_subset_sUnion Set.subset_union_right) hSᵣₚ₃)⟩
  | .assumption hp =>
    have ⟨S, hp'₁, hp'₂⟩ := Set.mem_sUnion.mp hp
    ⟨{S},
      Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hp'₁,
      Set.finite_singleton S,
      Set.sUnion_singleton _ ▸ ⟨.assumption hp'₂⟩⟩

name: single_set_of_proof
statement: lemma single_set_of_proof: IsChain (· ⊆ ·) Sᵢ → Sᵢ.Nonempty → ⋃₀ Sᵢ ⊢ p → ∃ Sⱼ: Set (Prop' A), Sⱼ ∈ Sᵢ ∧ Sⱼ ⊢ p
proof:
:= by
  intro hChain hNonempty hProves
  have ⟨Sᵢ', hSᵢ'₁, hSᵢ'₂, hSᵢ'₃⟩ := finite_family_of_proof hProves
  if hNonempty': Sᵢ'.Nonempty then
    have ⟨S, hS⟩ := hNonempty'
    have ⟨M, _, hM₁, hM₂⟩ := Set.Finite.exists_le_maximal hSᵢ'₂ hS
    refine ⟨M, hSᵢ'₁ hM₁, ?_⟩
    apply weaken ?_ hSᵢ'₃
    rw [Set.sUnion_subset_iff]
    intro Y hY
    if hYM: Y = M then
      exact Eq.subset hYM
    else
      have hChain': IsChain (· ⊆ ·) Sᵢ' := IsChain.mono hSᵢ'₁ hChain
      have := hChain' hY hM₁ hYM
      apply this.elim
      · exact id
      · exact hM₂ hY
  else
    have := Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hNonempty'
    have ⟨S, hS⟩ := hNonempty
    simp only [this, Set.sUnion_empty] at hSᵢ'₃
    exact ⟨S, hS, weaken_empty hSᵢ'₃⟩

name: lindenbaum
statement: lemma lindenbaum: consistent S → ∃ S' ⊇ S, complete S'
proof:
:=
  fun hS =>
    let P := { S' | consistent S' ∧ S ⊆ S' }
    have := zorn_subset_nonempty (S := P) <| by
      intro Sᵢ h₁ h₂ h₃
      refine ⟨⋃₀ Sᵢ, Set.mem_setOf.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · intro hpf
        have ⟨Sⱼ, hSⱼ₁, hSⱼ₂⟩ := single_set_of_proof h₂ h₃ hpf
        have ⟨this, _⟩ := h₁ hSⱼ₁
        exact this hSⱼ₂
      · have ⟨S₀, hS₀⟩ := Classical.indefiniteDescription _ h₃
        intro p hp
        exact ⟨S₀, hS₀, (h₁ hS₀).right hp⟩
      · intro S hS
        apply Set.subset_sUnion_of_subset Sᵢ S
        · exact subset_refl ..
        · exact hS
    have ⟨M, hM₁, hM₂, hM₃⟩ := this S ⟨hS, subset_refl S⟩
    have: ∀ p, M ⊢ p ∨ M ⊢ not p := fun p =>
      Classical.byCases
        .inl
        fun hn => .inr <|
          have: consistent (M ∪ {not p}) :=
            proof_iff_inconsistent_neg.not.mp hn
          have: M ∪ {p.not} ∈ P := ⟨this, Set.subset_union_of_subset_left hM₁ {p.not}⟩
          have: (not p) ∈ M :=
            have := hM₃ this Set.subset_union_left
            (Set.union_subset_iff.mp this).right rfl
          Nonempty.intro (.assumption this)
    ⟨M, hM₁, hM₂.left, this⟩

proof:
:= not_not.symm

name: proves_iff_truth_of_proves
statement:
lemma proves_iff_truth_of_proves? {S: Set (Prop' A)} {p: Prop' A}: complete S → (S ⊢ p ↔ truth (proves? S) p)
| h@⟨h₁, h₂⟩ => by
  match p with
  | ⊤ => simp only [proof_true', truth]
  | ⊥ =>
    refine (iff_false_right ?_).mpr h₁
    simp only [truth]
    exact Bool.false_ne_true
  | .atom a =>
    rw [truth, proves?, decide_eq_true_eq]
    rfl
  | .not q =>
    have hq
proof:
:= proves_iff_truth_of_proves? h (p := q)
    constructor <;> intro h'
    · rw [truth, Bool.not_iff_not.mpr]
      rw [←hq]
      intro hn
      exact no_proof_contradiction_of_consistent h₁ ⟨hn, h'⟩
    · apply (complete_proof_not_iff_not_proof h).mpr
      rw [truth, Bool.not_eq_true'] at h'
      rwa [h', Bool.false_eq_true, iff_false] at hq
  | .or q r =>
    have hq := proves_iff_truth_of_proves? h (p := q)
    have hr := proves_iff_truth_of_proves? h (p := r)
    rw [truth, Bool.or_eq_true]
    constructor
    · intro h'
      by_contra hn
      simp only [not_or, Bool.not_eq_true] at hn
      rw [hn.left, Bool.false_eq_true, iff_false] at hq
      rw [hn.right, Bool.false_eq_true, iff_false] at hr
      replace hq := (complete_proof_not_iff_not_proof h).mpr hq
      replace hr := (complete_proof_not_iff_not_proof h).mpr hr
      have: S ⊢ not (or q r) := mp₂ hq hr ⟨.axiom (.notOr q r)⟩
      exact no_proof_contradiction_of_consistent h₁ ⟨h', this⟩
    · rw [←hq, ←hr]
      rintro (h|h)
      · exact mp h ⟨.axiom (.inl q r)⟩
      · exact mp h ⟨.axiom (.inr r q)⟩
  | .and q r =>
    have hq := proves_iff_truth_of_proves? h (p := q)
    have hr := proves_iff_truth_of_proves? h (p := r)
    rw [truth, Bool.and_eq_true, ←hq, ←hr]
    constructor
    · intro h'
      have hq' := mp h' ⟨.axiom (.left q r)⟩
      have hr' := mp h' ⟨.axiom (.right q r)⟩
      exact ⟨hq', hr'⟩
    · intro ⟨hq', hr'⟩
      exact mp₂ hq' hr' ⟨.axiom (.and q r)⟩

name: proves
statement: lemma proves?_models: complete S → models (proves? S) S
proof:
:=
  fun hS _p hp => (proves_iff_truth_of_proves? hS).mp ⟨.assumption hp⟩

name: completeness
statement:
@[simp]
theorem completeness₂: consistent S ↔ ∃ t, models t S
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have ⟨S', hS'₁, hS'₂⟩ := lindenbaum h
    use proves? S'
    apply antitone_models hS'₁

name: Set.sUnion_of_singleton

name: finite_subset_of_proof
statement: lemma finite_subset_of_proof: S ⊢ p → ∃ S' ⊆ S, S'.Finite ∧ S' ⊢ p
proof:
:=
  fun h =>
    
    let family := Set.singleton '' S
    have hfamily: ⋃₀ family = S := Set.sUnion_of_singleton
    have ⟨family', hfamily'₁, hfamily'₂, hfamily'₃⟩ :=
      finite_family_of_proof (hfamily.symm ▸ h)
    ⟨⋃₀ family',
      hfamily.symm ▸ Set.sUnion_subset_sUnion hfamily'₁,
      Set.Finite.sUnion hfamily'₂ (fun t ht =>
        have := hfamily'₁ ht
        have ⟨_, _, ht'⟩ := (Set.mem_image Set.singleton S t).mp this
        ht' ▸ (Set.finite_singleton _)),
      hfamily'₃⟩

name: compactness
statement: theorem compactness₁: S ⊨ p → ∃ S₀ ⊆ S, S₀.Finite ∧ S₀ ⊨ p
proof:
:= by
  simp only [←completeness₁]
  exact finite_subset_of_proof

name: compactness
statement: theorem compactness₂: (∃ t, models t S) ↔ ∀ S₀ ⊆ S, S₀.Finite → ∃ t, models t S₀
proof:
:= by
  simp only [←completeness₂]
  constructor <;> intro h
  · intro S' hS'₁ hS'₂ hn
    exact h (weaken hS'₁ hn)
  · intro hn
    have ⟨S', hS'₁, hS'₂, hS'₃⟩ := finite_subset_of_proof hn
    apply h S' <;> assumption
